Thank you for testing. Please do not paste tokens, passwords, access keys or AWS account numbers.

**Which version?** (the first line of any command prints it, for example `Class platform teacher tools 2.0.2`)

**Where did you run it?** (AWS CloudShell, Linux, macOS, Windows PowerShell; Node version if on your own computer)

**What worked?**

**What stopped you, confused you or took longer than you expected?** (the exact message, and the step of the guide you were on)

**Did you get as far as a student publishing a site?** (yes / no / partly)

**Anything you expected the platform to do that it does not?**
